context: Doctor and teacher reflect on how the campaign moved public opinion
purpose: Teach: 療法/強力/圧倒的/振興/大衆/勢力/動向/報酬

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 今回の健康振興キャンペーン、世論への影響は圧倒的でしたね。
lines.en: This health promotion campaign had an overwhelming impact on public opinion.
lines.style: doctor opening with measured professional satisfaction and warmth

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本当にそう思います。新しい食事療法がこんなに大衆に受け入れられるとは思いませんでした。
lines.en: I truly agree. I never expected the new dietary therapy to be so embraced by the masses.
lines.style: teacher reflecting with mild astonishment and quiet warmth

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: メディアの動向を見ていると、健康志向の勢力が一気に広がったのが分かります。
lines.en: Looking at media trends, you can see how the health-conscious movement spread all at once.
lines.style: doctor analyzing data trends in clinical measured tone

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 学校でも生徒たちが食生活を見直し始めて、その変化は強力でしたよ。
lines.en: Even at school the students began rethinking their diets, and the change was powerful.
lines.style: teacher sharing classroom observation with quiet maternal pride

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 我々医師の努力に対する報酬は、こうして社会が動くことだと感じます。
lines.en: I feel that the reward for our efforts as doctors is seeing society move like this.
lines.style: doctor speaking with sincere humble conviction and gravity

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 先生方の声が届いたからこそですね。専門家の言葉には重みがありますから。
lines.en: It's precisely because the doctors' voices reached people. Experts' words carry weight.
lines.style: teacher acknowledging colleague with respectful sincere gratitude

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 次の振興策も同じくらい大衆の心を掴めると良いのですが。
lines.en: I hope the next promotion strategy can capture the public's hearts just as well.
lines.style: doctor expressing cautious forward-looking optimism with humility

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: きっと大丈夫です。世論の動向はもう確実にこちら側を向いていますから。
lines.en: I'm sure it'll be fine. The tide of public opinion is firmly on our side now.
lines.style: teacher reassuring with confident encouraging warmth and certainty
